equation_summary: Per token (naive.py:62-78): h <- h * exp(g_t) with g_t in R^K channel-wise log-decay along the KEY axis; erase = (b_t * k_t)^T h (gated read with channel-wise erase gate b in R^K); v_new = w_t * v_t - erase with channel-wise write gate w in R^V; h <- h + k_t v_new^T; o_t = (scale*q_t)^T h. Header comment (naive.py:10-17) gives the closed form S_t = (I - k_t (b_t*k_t)^T) Diag(exp(g_t)) S_{t-1} + k_t (w_t*v_t)^T and notes collapsing b=w=scalar beta recovers KDA. Distinct erase gate (K-axis) and write gate (V-axis) plus channel decay — NOT expressible as the canonical single-beta delta.
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/erase/write/decay gates] ; B[K2 distinct erase-write transition] ; E[norm/output]: the mixer takes b:[B,T,H,K] erase and w:[B,T,H,V] write as separate operands (naive.py:41-42), genuinely distinct factors.

CONFIRM blocker wording: 'no scalar-beta delta equivalence by naming' is correct — the transition (I - k(b*k)^T)Diag(exp(g)) has separate K-axis erase modulation b and V-axis write modulation w plus K-channel decay; only the degenerate b=w=beta scalar collapse equals the scalar-beta delta (naive.py:17).

MISSING-BLOCKER none severe, but note chunk reference (naive.py:150-200) materializes per-(i,j,K) decay tensors — any descriptor must record K-axis channel-decay cumsum semantics and both factor VJPs.
axis: A8 distinct erase/write transition factors (K-axis erase gate b, V-axis write gate w, plus K-channel decay) — generalizes the low-rank/diagonal-plus-rank-1 transition family
direction_justification: GDN2 differs from closed U2.D by a closed typed property — distinct per-channel erase and write factors on the rank-1 update with channel decay — reusable across the delta family, so it is an axis, not a one-off.
open_questions: Whether b and w must both be full per-channel tensors or whether low-rank/scalar special cases deserve named descriptor fields (source allows any [K] and [V] tensors).
Whether the KDA-collapse boundary (b=w=beta scalar) should be a legal coercion in the descriptor or kept structurally distinct.
